name: LGB Forge Limited
about: LGB Forge Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of forged and machined components in India. It provides auto, electrical, and transmission forged components for valve and infrastructure equipment industry comprising machining for customers in automotive, off-road, and non-automotive segments; and hot, warm, and cold forging products. The company also exports its products. LGB Forge Limited was founded in 1937 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
